binary.label: niri-computer-use binary
binary.description: Leave empty to use niri-computer-use from PATH, ~/.local/bin or ~/.cargo/bin.

notify_take.label: Notify when an agent takes the desktop
notify_take.description: A notification names the agent and its project.

notify_release.label: Notify when an agent gives the desktop back
notify_release.description: Off by default: the bar already shows it.

notify_stop.label: Notify when agents are stopped
notify_stop.description: By Stop, by your stop key or by niri-computer-use stop.

notify_errors.label: Notify when an agent's action fails
notify_errors.description: Off by default: agents retry most failures themselves. Never for an agent's own mistakes, such as invalid arguments.

glow_width.label: Glow width
glow_width.description: How wide the desktop glow's frame is, in pixels.

overlay.label: Show a robot where the agent acts
overlay.description: While an agent holds the desktop, a small robot and a caption sit beside each action's target. Clicks pass through them.

show_when_idle.label: Show while no agent drives
show_when_idle.description: Off hides the capsule until an agent takes the desktop.

show_client.label: Show the agent's name
show_client.description: Next to the robot while an agent drives.

idle.title: No agent on the desktop
idle.detail: Agents ask for the desktop before they act.

stopped.title: Agents are stopped
stopped.detail: Resume when you want them to act again.
stopped.stuck: Input may be stuck. Run niri-computer-use recover in a terminal, then resume.

offline.title: Not watching
offline.detail: niri-computer-use watch stopped answering. It starts again shortly.

missing.title: niri-computer-use not found
missing.detail: Install it, or set its path in this plugin's settings.

status.missing_hint: Install it, or set its path in this plugin's settings.

error.title: niri-computer-use watch failed
error.format: This niri-computer-use speaks a newer watch format. Update the plugin.
error.old: This niri-computer-use has no watch command. Update it, or set the path of a build that has one in this plugin's settings.

notify.took_body: Right-click the robot in the bar, or press your stop key, to stop it.
notify.stopped_body: Resume from the panel when you want them to act again.
notify.stuck_body: Run niri-computer-use recover in a terminal.
notify.outdated_body: An update replaced niri-computer-use. Restart those agents, or reconnect their MCP server, to use the new build.
notify.restart_body: Its calls fail with {error}: an update replaced its server, which lost the shared engine. Restart the agent, or reconnect its MCP server.

error.timed_out: It took more than five seconds.

bar.agents_outdated: Connected agents: {n} · {old} on an old build
bar.hint_stop: Click for details · right-click to stop agents
bar.hint_resume: Click for details · right-click to resume agents

panel.stop_hint: Ends the running action and takes the desktop back, like your stop key.
panel.agents_old_one: 1 on an old build, restart it
panel.agents_old: {n} on an old build, restart them
panel.empty: No calls on this desktop yet.

action.zoom: Zoomed into part of the screen
action.region: Looked at part of the screen
